limitations: Standard shared-pool overlapping-neighborhood payoff, fixed cutoff, finite positive Fermi noise, regular networks; no claim for dynamically estimated thresholds, conformity, mutation, heterogeneous groups, or cutoffs below the sharp boundary.
The 2023 motivating paper uses ambiguous notation for the defector group-benefit term; the theorem fixes the conventional interpretation explicitly.
Independent validation and priority audit are not completed.
title: Sharp payoff-blindness threshold for network public-goods imitation
